# discorddol

> Discord data object layers: read guilds, channels, threads and messages as Mappings


## Pages in this subsection

- [discorddol](discorddol.html.md): Discord data object layers: read guilds, channels, threads and messages as Mappings.
- [discorddol.base](discorddol.base.html.md): Core of discorddol: a Discord read backend and the &#96;Mapping&#96; stores over it.
- [discorddol.export](discorddol.export.html.md): Export a whole guild to disk: every channel the bot can read, one JSONL file each.
- [discorddol.local_cache](discorddol.local_cache.html.md): Read the Discord desktop client’s on-disk HTTP cache – including for deleted channels.
- [discorddol.tools](discorddol.tools.html.md): SSOT verb list for discorddol: plain functions, JSON-able in, JSON-able out.
